title: Compare bandit strategies across repeated runs
description: You aggregate cumulative rewards and display variation between runs.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You allocate one row of cumulative rewards per run for each of three strategies. Each row has T funding rounds.
You construct fresh strategy objects for every run. Each simulation receives a sampled seed, and its running reward totals fill one array row.

steps.question: What do the shaded lower and upper boundaries represent?
steps.answer: They are the supplied lower and upper percentiles across runs at each round. The central curve uses the mean cumulative reward.

steps.description: You plot one mean curve and percentile band per strategy. The axes compare cumulative reward by round; the supplied output contains no numeric ranking.
